report.model_summary: Paid November revenue grew from $189,316.83 to $304,396.67 (+$115,079.84, +61%) with no SQL change. The prior Nov 24 refresh only contained orders through Nov 24, while the Dec 1 refresh adds Nov 25-30 including Black Friday/Cyber Monday: 1,077 late-period orders for $106,760.98 plus ~$8,318.86 of early-period backfill. Daily volume spikes to 304 orders ($27,698.13) on Nov 27 and 287 orders ($29,183.73) on Nov 30 versus ~80-90/day earlier, with correct date, status, and refund filtering.
